ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $C$ is on the line segment $AB$, and point $D$ is the midpoint of the line segment $AB$. If $AC=6\,cm$ and $BC=3\,cm$, what is the length of the line segment $CD$ in $cm$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AC=6\,cm$, $BC=3\,cm$,

it follows that $AB=AC+BC=6+3=9\,cm$,

Since point D is the midpoint of segment AB,

it follows that $AD=\frac{1}{2}AB=\frac{1}{2}\times9=4.5\,cm$,

thus $CD=AC-AD=6-4.5=\boxed{1.5}\,cm$
